🚀 Система навигации

Сохранение позиции (SET BASE): Позволяет вручную запомнить координаты вашего участка. Это гарантирует, что телепорт на базу всегда будет работать точно, даже если автоматика не нашла ваш плот.
Умная продажа (SELL): Идеальный инструмент для продуктивной работы. Скрипт запоминает, где вы находитесь, переносит вас на базу на 5 секунд для реализации ресурсов и автоматически возвращает обратно в ту же точку.
⚡ Дополнительные возможности
Настройка скорости: Управляйте темпом своего передвижения через текстовое поле.
Воздушная навигация: Подготовка функционала для перемещения в воздухе без ограничений.
EN | English Version
Title: UtilityHub Pro
🚀 Navigation Hub
Instant Travel: Dedicated buttons for fast movement between key locations: BASE, SHOP, and WORK ZONE.
Coordinate Memory (SET BASE): Allows you to manually save your plot's exact location. This ensures the base teleport always works perfectly, even if the auto-finder misses your plot.
Smart Sell: The ultimate productivity tool. The script marks your current spot, teleports you to the base for 5 seconds to process your resources, and instantly returns you to your exact previous position.
⚡ Extra Features
Speed Control: Customize your movement pace using the built-in text input.
Air Navigation: Functional setup for unlimited jumping and vertical freedom.

local function playToggleSound()
	pcall(function()
		toggleSound.TimePosition = 0
		toggleSound:Play()
	end)
end

local function updateUI()
	if enabled then
		toggle.Text = "■   DISABLE TELEPORT"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 150, 105)
		status.Text = "STATUS: ACTIVE"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 240, 170)
	else

		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 49, 66)
		status.Text = "STATUS: DISABLED"
		status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 185)
	end
end

local function teleportOnce()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	-- This is intended for your own Roblox experience.
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(TARGET_POSITION)
end

local function startTeleportLoop()
	if teleporting then return end
	teleporting = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while enabled do
			local ok, err = pcall(teleportOnce)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Teleport Panel] Teleport error:", err)
			end

			task.wait(TELEPORT_INTERVAL)
		end

		teleporting = false
	end)
end

local function setEnabled(value)
	if enabled == value then return end

	enabled = value
	updateUI()
	playToggleSound()

	if enabled then
		startTeleportLoop()
	end
end

toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
	setEnabled(not enabled)
end)

--Insert
local function setPanelOpen(value)
	panelOpen = value

	if panelOpen then
		main.Visible = true
		main.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		TweenService:Create(
			main,
			TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{BackgroundTransparency = 0}
		):Play()
	else
		main.Visible = false
	end
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
		setPanelOpen(not panelOpen)
	end
end)

hideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setPanelOpen(false)
end)

closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setEnabled(false)
	gui:Destroy()
end)

-- panel
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos
local dragInput

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = main.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Auto chat script mobile friendly open source
scripts.script:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService
local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral")

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MobileAutoChatGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.45)
frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.075, 0.275)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.Parent = gui
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)

local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding", frame)
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.03, 0)
padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.03, 0)
padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0.05, 0)
padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0.05, 0)

-- Message box
local msgBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
msgBox.PlaceholderText = "Type message to auto chat"
msgBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.25)
msgBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
msgBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
msgBox.TextScaled = true
msgBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
msgBox.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", msgBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- Delay box
local delayBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
delayBox.PlaceholderText = "Delay (seconds)"
delayBox.Text = "10"
delayBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.2)
delayBox.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.32)
delayBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
delayBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
delayBox.TextScaled = true
delayBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
delayBox.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", delayBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- ON/OFF toggle button
local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Text = "OFF"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.25)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.62)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local running = false

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	running = not running

	if running then
		toggleBtn.Text = "ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 0)
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "OFF"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 0)
	end
end)

-- Auto chat loop
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if running then
			local delayTime = tonumber(delayBox.Text)
			if delayTime and delayTime >= 1 and msgBox.Text ~= "" then
				channel:SendAsync(msgBox.Text)
				task.wait(delayTime)
			else
				task.wait(1)
			end
		else
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end
end)
